external_games.name: BubbleBack: The Story of Forward to the Past 2

name: BubbleBack: The Story of Forward to the Past 2
storyline:
Following Dave's botched attempt at time travel in 2021, a hole has appeared in the space time continuum. This has allowed an evil Baron to enter our realm, kidnap Dave and turn Nate into a bubble dragon, as that's the sort of messed up thing the Baron likes to do.

It's up to you, as Nate's bubble dragon alter ego, to collect 86 bubbles to break the Baron's spell. This will turn Nate back into a human kid, banish the Baron & remove Dave's cage, enabling you to go find and SAVE DAVE!
- Itch.io page
summary: The long awaited sequel to Forward to the Past, featuring music by the award winning Lee Bee!
